cases.name: format_toplevel_row

cases.name: mapping_drop_fields

cases.name: mapping_blank_name
cases.doc: 빈 문자열로 덮어써 값 의미가 깨진다.

cases.name: range_fixed_pages

cases.name: boundary_empty_shortcut
